Re: Side Letter — Series A Preferred Stock Purchase Agreement dated April 14, 2026

Ladies and Gentlemen:

This side letter is entered into in connection with the Series A Preferred Stock Purchase Agreement of even date between Corvid Bioworks, Inc. (the "Company") and the purchasers named in it (the "Purchase Agreement"), and with the Amended and Restated Investors' Rights Agreement of even date (the "IRA"). Capitalized terms used and not defined in this letter have the meanings given in the Purchase Agreement.

In consideration of Harbourline Ventures II, L.P.'s ("Harbourline") purchase of Series A Preferred Stock, and notwithstanding anything to the contrary in the Purchase Agreement or the IRA, the Company agrees as follows:

1. Information Rights. For so long as Harbourline holds at least 1,000,000 shares of Preferred Stock (as adjusted for any stock split, combination, or recapitalization), the Company will deliver to Harbourline the financial statements described in Section 3.1 of the IRA without regard to the Major Investor threshold in that Section, and will permit Harbourline to inspect the Company's records on reasonable notice.

2. Pro Rata Rights. Harbourline has the right of first offer described in Section 4 of the IRA on the same terms as a Major Investor, without regard to the threshold in that Section, for so long as Harbourline holds any Preferred Stock.

3. Board Observer. For so long as Harbourline holds at least 1,000,000 shares of Preferred Stock, Harbourline may designate one representative to attend all meetings of the Board of Directors in a non-voting observer capacity. The Company will give the observer the same notice and materials it gives a director, except that the Company may exclude the observer from any portion of a meeting, and withhold any material, where the Board determines in good faith that exclusion is reasonably necessary to preserve the attorney-client privilege or to avoid a conflict of interest. The observer will hold all information received in confidence and will execute the Company's standard confidentiality agreement before attending.

4. No Assignment. The rights in this letter are personal to Harbourline and may not be assigned, except to an affiliate of Harbourline that acquires the Preferred Stock and agrees in writing to be bound by this letter.

5. Termination. This letter terminates automatically on the earlier of (a) the closing of a firm-commitment underwritten public offering of the Company's common stock, and (b) a Deemed Liquidation Event as the Company's certificate of incorporation defines it.

6. Miscellaneous. This letter is governed by Delaware law. It may be amended only in a writing signed by the Company and Harbourline. Except as expressly provided here, the Purchase Agreement and the IRA remain in full force and effect.

Please countersign below to confirm your agreement.

Very truly yours,

CORVID BIOWORKS, INC.

By: /s/ Ilona Reyes

Title: Chief Executive Officer
